nodeUrl.label: Imajin Node URL
nodeUrl.help: URL of the Imajin node to connect to (e.g. https://jin.imajin.ai)

did.label: Agent DID
did.help: The agent's decentralized identifier on the Imajin network

keypairPath.label: Keypair Path
keypairPath.help: Path to the Ed25519 keypair JSON file for signing

actAs.label: Default Acting-For DID
actAs.help: Default principal the agent acts on behalf of (X-Acting-For). Delegated writes (media/attest/transact/chat) default to this DID unless a call passes an explicit onBehalfOf. The agent must have role:agent membership on this DID.

attestation.serviceUrl.label: Attestation Service URL
attestation.serviceUrl.help: Base URL of the Imajin kernel's internal attestations endpoint. Defaults to nodeUrl when omitted.

attestation.internalApiKey.label: Attestation Internal API Key
attestation.internalApiKey.help: Bearer token for POST /auth/api/attestations/internal. Falls back to the ATTESTATION_INTERNAL_API_KEY env var when omitted.

wsNotifications.hookToken.label: Wake Hook Token
wsNotifications.hookToken.help: Bearer token for the Gateway's POST /hooks/agent (#18), matching that Gateway's hooks.token. Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object ({ source, provider, id }, #20) resolved via the plugin SDK — recommended so the same secrets-store entry backs both this plugin and the Gateway's hooks.token. Falls back to the IMAJIN_WAKE_HOOK_TOKEN env var when omitted or unresolvable. Never logged.

approvalBridge.pinnedApproverPublicKeyHe.label: Approval Bridge: Pinned Approver Public Key
approvalBridge.pinnedApproverPublicKeyHe.help: Ed25519 public key (hex) of the sole trusted human approver for OpenClaw gateway approval decisions signed on /jin (#1816). Channel/WS auth alone never resolves an approval — only a signature from this key does.

approvals.enabled.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Enabled
approvals.enabled.help: Publish staged Gateway system-agent proposals (restart / config mutation) to the kernel and apply signed operator decisions from /jin back to the Gateway (#24). Off by default; requires did + keypairPath + operatorDid + notifyWebhookSecret.

approvals.operatorDid.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Operator DID
approvals.operatorDid.help: The Imajin DID of the human operator who decides proposals on /jin. The kernel notification is addressed to this DID and the returned operator.approval.decided event is only ever trusted when every identity field matches it exactly.

approvals.sources.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Sources
approvals.sources.help: Which approval sources to drive (#33): "system-agent" (OpenClaw gateway restart / config-mutation proposals) and/or "skill-workshop" (pending Skill Workshop skill proposals). Defaults to both. A source left out of this list neither lists nor subscribes.

approvals.gatewayToken.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Gateway Token
approvals.gatewayToken.help: Optional bearer override for the plugin's own loopback OpenClaw Gateway operator connection (scopes: ["operator.approvals"]). Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object ({source, provider, id}), resolved via the plugin SDK. When omitted, Gateway auth is resolved automatically from the host's own gateway config (the same mechanism the existing approvalBridge feature already relies on). Never logged.

approvals.notifyWebhookSecret.label: Gateway Approvals Bridge: Kernel Notify Webhook Secret
approvals.notifyWebhookSecret.help: Bearer value for the kernel's POST /notify/api/send x-webhook-secret header (that kernel's NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object, resolved via the plugin SDK. Falls back to the IMAJIN_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var when omitted. Required for the bridge to publish anything. Never logged.

wsNotifications.stateDir.label: Notification State Directory
wsNotifications.stateDir.help: Directory for the ack-dedup LRU and pending-wake persistence files (#26). Defaults to a directory colocated with keypairPath.

wsNotifications.wakeOwedMaxAgeMs.label: Owed Wake Max Age (ms)
wsNotifications.wakeOwedMaxAgeMs.help: Age bound for a persisted 'wake owed' marker replayed at startup (#30). A marker older than this is dropped — already durably injected — instead of firing a stale wake. Default 3600000 (1h).

actAs.description: Default acting-for DID (X-Acting-For). Delegated writes default to this principal unless onBehalfOf is passed explicitly.

wsNotifications.description: Configure which WS notification scopes trigger agent session injection (#1672)

injectScopes.description: Notification scopes that trigger agent wake-up (e.g. warp.run.completed)

targetSession.description: Session key to inject notifications into

wakeSessionKey.description: Session key to wake with a real agent turn via the Gateway's POST /hooks/agent (#18). Defaults to targetSession.

wakeSettleMs.description: Leading-edge settle window for Warp wake turns, in ms (#25). The first qualifying notification in an idle window fires its own wake after this delay; anything joining before it fires batches into that same leading wake. Default 10000 (10s).

wakeCoalesceMs.description: Trailing coalesce window for Warp wake turns, in ms, measured from the leading wake (#25). Any notification arriving in this window after the leading wake fires batches into ONE follow-up wake at the window's end. Default 30000 (30s, was 300000/5min).

wakeOwedMaxAgeMs.description: Age bound, in ms, for a persisted 'wake owed' marker replayed at startup (#30). A marker older than this is dropped instead of firing a stale wake — its frames already reached the agent via the durable system-event queue — and logged as expired. Default 3600000 (1h).

hookToken.description: Bearer token for the Gateway's POST /hooks/agent, matching that Gateway's hooks.token. Accepts a plain string or a SecretRef object (#20), resolved once via the plugin SDK. Falls back to the IMAJIN_WAKE_HOOK_TOKEN env var when omitted or unresolvable.

hooksPath.description: Gateway hooks base path (matching that Gateway's hooks.path). Default /hooks.

hookAgentId.description: Agent id to route the wake hook to (must be permitted by that Gateway's hooks.allowedAgentIds). Default main.

stateDir.description: Directory for this injector's persisted state (#26): the ack-dedup LRU (notification-ack-dedup.json) and pending-wake markers (pending-wakes.json). Defaults to a directory colocated with keypairPath.

directSend.description: Direct channel ping via the OpenClaw CLI — deterministic, no model turn. Also the #14 fallback destination when the wake hook is disabled or unreachable.

cliPath.description: Absolute path to the openclaw CLI binary; default openclaw (PATH).

attestation.description: Configure the agent_end → agent.turn.usage attestation hook (#1843)

enabled.description: Explicit opt-out. Defaults to true when serviceUrl + internalApiKey both resolve.

serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the attestation service. Defaults to nodeUrl.

internalApiKey.description: Bearer token for POST /auth/api/attestations/internal. Falls back to the ATTESTATION_INTERNAL_API_KEY env var.

approvalBridge.description: Route OpenClaw gateway approval requests (exec elevation, Skill Workshop lifecycle) to /jin and resolve them from signed decisions (#1816). Requires did + keypairPath.

pinnedApproverPublicKeyHex.description: Ed25519 public key (hex) of the sole trusted human approver. A decision is resolved only when it carries a valid signature from this exact key, references the matching request id, and arrives before the request's expiry.

approvals.description: Gateway approvals bridge (#24): publish staged Gateway system-agent proposals to the kernel as operator.approval.requested, and apply signed operator.approval.decided decisions from /jin back to the Gateway's own approval store. Additive and off by default; requires did + keypairPath.

enabled.description: Explicit opt-in. Off unless true, even if the other approvals.* fields are set.

operatorDid.description: The operator's Imajin DID (did:imajin:...). The kernel notification is addressed to this DID; a decided event is only trusted when issuer/subject/decidedBy all equal it exactly.

sources.description: Which approval sources to drive (#33). Defaults to ["system-agent", "skill-workshop"] (both) when omitted. A source left out neither lists nor subscribes — no bridge-code changes are needed to add or remove a source.

gatewayToken.description: Optional bearer override for the plugin's own loopback Gateway operator connection. A plain string or a SecretRef object, resolved once via the plugin SDK. Optional: Gateway auth otherwise resolves automatically from the host's own gateway config.

notifyWebhookSecret.description: Bearer value for the kernel's POST /notify/api/send x-webhook-secret header. A plain string or a SecretRef object, resolved once via the plugin SDK. Falls back to the IMAJIN_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var. Required for the bridge to publish anything.
